# Senior Backend Engineer — Nimbus Freight (fictional company)
Remote — Mexico or Colombia (contractor or employee via EOR)

Nimbus Freight builds software for mid-size trucking companies in North America.

## You will
- Design and own Python services for shipment tracking.
- Improve reliability of event-driven pipelines.
- Mentor engineers and review code.

## Must have
- 4+ years of backend development with Python
- PostgreSQL in production
- Message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS)
- Kubernetes in production
- Professional English

## Nice to have
- Logistics or e-commerce domain
- Terraform

Salary: USD 4,000–5,500 / month
